baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Used when no application.yml/properties gives a port and context-path, e.g. http://localhost:8080.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: How long a Send Request call may wait before it is reported as timed out.

extraHeaders.title: Extra headers
extraHeaders.description: One Name: Value per line, added to every request this plugin sends (for example an auth cookie).

groupBy.title: Group the route tree by
groupBy.description: module: the path before /src/main/; controller: the controller class.

maxDepth.title: Max nesting depth
maxDepth.description: Nested objects deeper than this become {} (default 4).

skipSerialVersionUid.title: Skip serialVersionUID
skipSerialVersionUid.description: Leave serialVersionUID out of generated JSON and Bulk Value (default on).

excludeTests.title: Exclude test files
excludeTests.description: Leave routes in test sources out of the index (tests/, test_*.py, *Test.java, src/test/…).

excludeGlobs.title: Excluded path globs
excludeGlobs.description: Comma or newline separated globs; empty keeps the built-in defaults.

projectPrefixFilter.title: Project prefix filter
projectPrefixFilter.description: When set, only routes from files whose path contains this text are indexed (e.g. haiyi-ai-commercial/backend).

activeProfile.title: Spring profile
activeProfile.description: Overrides spring.profiles.active when reading application-<profile>.* files; empty means read it from the config.
